docClose.hint: jq-helpers.ps1 set_last; unix/jq-helpers.sh set_last; append_research if Action touched .cursor/

actionOpen: If docClose.pending is true, run jq-helpers set_last (and append_research if .cursor/ was touched) before claiming done.
State interpreted intent, INDEX/l0 evidence, confidence: high | medium | low.
Low confidence: Blocking + Questions only; no writes until user answers.
Progressive research: INDEX then at most one l1 and one l2; append log.research[] each step.
If tiers leave ambiguity: clarify (Blocking / Questions / Context); do not guess.
After edits: log.last, current.json, tiers, manifest if harness changed.
